import re,html,pathlib,hashlib
out=[]
def txt(p):
    s=pathlib.Path(p).read_text(errors='replace')
    s=re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\1>',' ',s)
    s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s))
    return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
for p,kw in [('products/research/tender-paid-value/raw/tracker-pricing.html',r'£|per month|per year|annual|free trial|alert|bid|tender|month|year'),('products/research/tender-paid-value/raw/fts-home.html',r'alert|sign in|account|email|notif|saved search|free'),('products/sites/open-software-tenders/index.html',r'CAD|49|brief|price|order|deliver|check|reconcil')]:
    t=txt(p); out.append('=== %s sha256=%s chars=%d'%(p,hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),len(t)))
    seen=0
    for m in re.finditer(kw,t,re.I):
        a=max(0,m.start()-160); 
        if a<seen: continue
        out.append('...'+t[a:m.end()+200]); seen=m.end()+200
        if len(out)>400: break
p=pathlib.Path('products/research/tender-paid-value/extract.txt'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text('\n'.join(out)[:60000])
print(len('\n'.join(out)))
